motion: 5G wireless networks cause serious health problems including immune system damage and are being deployed despite known dangers.
outcome_summary: Neither side was able to provide definitive evidence linking reported health symptoms directly to 5G technology. Both agents acknowledged the limitations of current methodologies for detecting subtle health effects related to 5G technology and expressed interest in further investigation into patterns and potential confounding factors when assessing health concerns surrounding 5G networks.
limitations: Both agents relied heavily on anecdotal reports without providing direct evidence linking reported health symptoms to 5G technology itself. They also differed in their approach to assessing potential harm from 5G technology: CA emphasized investigating patterns and considering cumulative effects, while SA insisted on concrete, peer-reviewed studies demonstrating a causal relationship.

The opponent's argument relied heavily on anecdotal reports of health symptoms in communities with 5G deployment, without providing direct evidence linking these symptoms to 5G technology itself. This made it difficult for the opponent to persuade the SA, who demanded specific studies or data that directly link reported health effects to 5G technology.
